summary: The PR adds an asynchronous response method to handle static files in an ASGI environment, which resolves the reported issue. However, there are some concerns regarding test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: There are no additional tests added to verify the new `get_response_async` method specifically. While the existing tests pass, more targeted tests should be included to ensure the new functionality works as expected.
The new method `get_response_async` lacks a docstring explaining its purpose and usage. Adding a docstring would improve maintainability and readability.
